The first operational step is robust population health analytics. Leveraging an integrated electronic health record (EHR) platform coupled with a dedicated analytics engine enables real‑time risk stratification using CMS’s risk adjustment factors plus additional social determinants of health variables that predict utilization. Finally, establishing a governance structure that includes clinical leaders, data analysts, and quality improvement specialists ensures that insights from performance dashboards translate into actionable change.
